info.name: Text cursor blinking remover
info.description: I've removed text cursor blinking for websites using many of the most common caret frameworks and some of the websites I use a lot. Works with google docs (and many more websites).
info.additionalInfo:
Might expand upon it in the future. 
I did use a lot of AI to formulate the code, but I did have to manually inspect websites I often use to find the code that causes cursor blinking. Some of the points in the code might be hallucination.
